meta.readMe: The pool is the top DPS rankings for one spec, which biases it toward fast kills: a mechanic that only appears late may be under-represented or absent, and 'journalOnly' lists catalogued abilities the pool never cast. Times are given both from the pull start (atSeconds) and from the start of the phase segment they landed in (atSegmentSeconds); the second is the stable one. A segment index is not a phase number -- phases repeat, so read phaseId/cycle.

journal.title: Barbed Bulwark
journal.description:
Blood Torrent protects each Caustic Globule, inflicting 500044 Shadow damage and knocking back players while it persists.

Interrupting Barbed Bulwark destroys it.

journal.title: Blood Torrent
journal.description:
Ithraz channels a torrent of blood into his target for 5 sec. Every 1 sec, the torrent applies a 426295 healing absorb to the target. This effect stacks.

Expunged blood coalesces around each Caustic Globule, forming a Barbed Bulwark.

journal.title: Caustic Deluge
journal.description:
Vexhul funnels toxin into her current target for 5 sec, inflicting 250022 Nature damage every 0.5 sec and ejecting acid nearby.

Each acid splash inflicts 916747 Nature damage and applies Eternal Venom to players within 4 yards, forming a Caustic Globule at the impact location.

journal.title: Caustic Globule
journal.description:
An acidic globule forms and ruptures after 10 sec, inflicting 625055 Nature damage and applying Eternal Venom to all players.

Upon contact, the globule instead only affects that player.

journal.title: Coiling Ichor
journal.description:
Ithraz infuses several players with vile ichor, inflicting 75007 Shadow damage to players within 0 yards every 1 sec for 12 sec. Over time, the ichor inflicts increasing damage as it shrinks in area.

Upon expiration, the ichor forms a pool of Congealed Gore.

journal.title: Corrosive Spit
journal.description: The spawn focuses on a player and spews toxin in a frontal line, inflicting 666725 Nature damage and applying Eternal Venom to players struck.

journal.title: Envenomed
journal.description: Caustic Deluge damage increases damage taken from Caustic Deluge by 10% for 1.5 min. This effect stacks.

journal.title: Eternal Venom
journal.description:
Being struck by some abilities causes an everlasting venom to course through the target's veins, inflicting 10001 Nature damage every 1 sec. This effect stacks.

Upon reaching 11 applications, the target dies.

journal.title: Ravenous Feast
journal.description:
Ithraz attempts to consume players 3 times in quick succession. Each strike inflicts 4625407 Physical damage split evenly among players within 14 yards.

Ithraz consumes 1 application of Eternal Venom from players struck, applying Feasted to them and knocking them away.

If Ravenous Feast fails to hit at least 4 targets all players suffer the full effect.

journal.title: Rouse the Brood
journal.description: Ithraz thrashes, calling several Broodlings of Ithraz to the surface and releasing a nova of blood that inflicts 208352 Shadow damage to all players.

journal.title: Sanguine Storm
journal.description: Ithraz showers the platform with globs of gore for 18 sec. Each impact inflicts 500044 Shadow damage to players within 4 yards.

journal.title: Stir the Depths
journal.description:
Vexhul thrashes and churns the surrounding sea of venom for 6 sec, inflicting 166681 Nature damage to all players every 2 sec and forming waves.

The waves travel across the platform, inflicting 125011 Nature damage every 1 sec and applying Eternal Venom to players struck.

journal.title: Stone Breaker
journal.description:
Ithraz roars, pushing players away. He then slams the platform repeatedly. Each impact inflicts 2500220 Physical damage to players within 3.5 yards and increases their damage taken from Stone Breaker by 33% for 1.5 min. This effect stacks.

If no players are struck, Ithraz instead inflicts 916747 Physical damage to all players and knocks them away. This effect ignores armor.

journal.title: Venomous Emergence
journal.description: Vexhul calls her progeny from the churning sea, inflicting 125011 Nature damage and applying Eternal Venom to all players.

journal.title: Vile Flood
journal.description: Vexhul channels a continuous torrent of toxin in a frontal direction for 14 sec, inflicting 416703 Nature damage every 0.5 sec and applying Eternal Venom to players struck.

journal.title: Clotted Bolt
journal.description: Ithraz lances his current target with gore if they are out of range, inflicting Shadow damage.

journal.title: Concentrated Spittle
journal.description: Vexhul pelts her current target with spittle if they are out of range, inflicting Nature damage.

journal.title: Visceral Burst
journal.description:
The broodling convulses, releasing a violent burst that inflicts 625055 Shadow damage to all players and an additional 208352 Shadow damage every 1 sec for 6 sec. This effect stacks.

If interrupted, the broodling retreats to the depths below.
